findings.explanation: The client can terminate the contract immediately based on their own subjective judgment that your performance is adversely affected, creating a one-sided risk for you.
findings.suggested_change: Either party may terminate this Agreement upon material breach by the other party that remains uncured after written notice.

findings.explanation: If the client terminates the contract, no compensation or indemnification is required, meaning you might not get paid for completed work.
findings.suggested_change: Upon termination by either party, the Client shall pay the Contractor for all work performed and expenses incurred up to the effective date of termination.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body:
Hello, I hope this email finds you well. I have reviewed the agreement and would like to propose a few minor adjustments before we proceed with signing.

- Regarding the clause stating that the unaffected party may terminate the agreement based on a subjective judgment of performance, I would prefer to clarify this so that either party may terminate upon an uncured material breach.
- Regarding the clause stating that no compensation is required upon unilateral termination, I propose adding that the client shall pay for all work performed and expenses incurred up to the effective date of termination.

Thank you for considering these adjustments. I look forward to finalizing the agreement.

Best regards
